_meta.description: 12 evaluation queries for the CloudBox Multi-Source RAG system, each with ground truth for Hit@K / MRR.
_meta.chunk_id_convention: docs:<file_slug>:<section_slug> | forum:<thread_id> | blog:<file_slug>:<section_slug> (prefix maps from source_type: documentation -> docs, forum -> forum, blog -> blog)
_meta.slug_rule: lowercase; spaces -> hyphens; non-alphanumeric stripped (front-matter 'slug' for file part, '##' heading for section part)
_meta.hit_k_note: A query is a hit at K if ANY id in expected_doc_ids appears in the final top-K evidence of a pipeline variant.
_meta.conflict_case_note: One of: storage | upload-size | 2fa | linux | null. The 4 conflict queries double as regression tests for the conflict rules.

queries.query: How much free storage do I get with CloudBox?
queries.expected_answer_facts: The free plan includes 10 GB of storage (raised from 5 GB in v2.0, September 2023).

queries.query: What is the largest file I can upload to CloudBox?
queries.expected_answer_facts: 20 GB through desktop/mobile clients and API; 2 GB through the web app.

queries.query: Is two-factor authentication required for organization accounts?
queries.expected_answer_facts: Required for all organization accounts since v2.1 (May 2024); optional for personal accounts.

queries.query: Does CloudBox have a Linux client?
queries.expected_answer_facts: Yes — official Linux desktop client since v2.0 (September 2023); Ubuntu 20.04+ and Fedora 36+.

queries.query: How do I share a file with someone outside my organization?
queries.expected_answer_facts: Create a share link with View/Edit/Comment permission; external users do not need an account; optional expiry and password.

queries.query: My sync client has been stuck on 'Syncing…' for hours. What should I do?
queries.expected_answer_facts: Pause/resume sync, check proxy/firewall settings, clear the local cache, restart the client, then open a ticket with logs.

queries.query: Can I recover a file I deleted 45 days ago?
queries.expected_answer_facts: Free plan keeps deleted items 30 days (too late); paid plans 90 days (recoverable if not emptied).

queries.query: How do I set up selective sync to save disk space?
queries.expected_answer_facts: Desktop client Preferences > Sync tab > Selective Sync; uncheck folders to keep them cloud-only; excluded folders still count toward quota.

queries.query: What happens to my shared links when I downgrade my plan?
queries.expected_answer_facts: Over-quota files become read-only for 90 days (links still view/download, uploads blocked); after 90 days files move to the recycle bin and links expire.

queries.query: What are best practices for organizing team folders at scale?
queries.expected_answer_facts: One team folder per department, max 2-3 levels, grant access via member groups, consistent naming conventions with YYYY-MM-DD dates.

queries.query: Users report uploads failing for files over 2 GB — why?
queries.expected_answer_facts: Web-app uploads are capped at 2 GB per file; the desktop client supports up to 20 GB. Expected behavior, not a bug.

queries.query: Does CloudBox encrypt files at rest?
queries.expected_answer_facts: Yes — AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit; keys held by CloudBox (not zero-knowledge).
